policy: Port the desktop macOS application. The rejected Windows preview and raw game-only scene are not an application reference. Shared game assets are permitted only as used by this macOS source. Mac 1.3.2 (build 21) is commit cc190ca7cf4853c9c6ebe0b0443be13203b23fa7 (Mac 1.3.1 build 20, commit 3a095f3ee3b7e69a3e56bee9075298787e6e49ee, plus: the leaving page of a sub-page swap kept as drawn, re-renders held until the swap's page lands, the leaving Storage page kept on the old disk's readings during a disk switch, input and Now Playing readings kept off the leaving page, a dragged module row or TODO card put back when its page leaves mid-drag, and the 1.3.2 version on top of 1.3.1); the pinned commit's Sources and Resources trees are that release's, and the shared Resources/Fonts/manifest.json carries the windows platform for HarmonyOS Sans (the Mac reads the macos platform only).
